mechanics.claim: Enemies can only be hit once per pass of the shell.
mechanics.quote: Enemies can only be hit once per pass.

mechanics.claim: The powder trail detonates after 2 seconds, or after a 0.2s delay if it collides with terrain, dealing a separate damage instance.
mechanics.quote: After 2 seconds, or {{rutngt|0.2}} upon colliding with terrain, the round detonates to deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within a wide perpendicular area

mechanics.claim: A spell shield can only block one instance of the ability's damage (the initial hit or the detonation, not both).
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} can only block one instance of the ability's damage.
